# 2025 Billie Jean King Cup finals

The Billie Jean King Cup Finals will be the highest level of the Billie Jean King Cup tennis team competition in 2025. The event will take place in Shenzhen, China, from 16-21 September 2025 The ties contested will be a best-of-three rubbers format, played on one day, consisting of two singles where needed followed by a doubles rubber. The finals will feature 8 teams competing in a knockout format.
Billie Jean King Cup finals
Date: 16–21 September 2025
Venue: Shenzhen Bay Sports Center, Shenzhen, China
Surface: Hard indoor
8 nations will take part in the Finals. The qualification is as follows:
* 6 qualifying round group winners
* 1 defending champion (Italy)
* 1 host nation (China)
